方向移动 · A 确认／编辑 · B 返回 · LB／RB 切换区域: D-pad to move · A to confirm/edit · B to go back · LB/RB to switch regions
横坐标需按从小到大排列，且所有值都需有效。: X coordinates must be in ascending order and all values must be valid.
选择映射使用的接口。需要体感时，请选择标有「体感可用」的接口。: Choose an interface for mapping. For motion input, select one marked Gyro available.
上次选择的接口 · 等待连接: Previously selected interface · Waiting for connection
暂无可访问的体感接口。请检查第三方接管模式及 HidHide 读取权限。: No accessible gyro interface. Check third-party takeover mode and HidHide access permissions.
此接口未报告扩展按键。: This interface reports no extra buttons.
开始观察后显示实时输入。: Start monitoring to see live input.
在组件页检测驱动和管理实体手柄可见性。: Check drivers and manage physical controller visibility on the Components page.
调整中 · 左右微调，上下 10 步: Adjusting · Left/right for fine steps, up/down for 10 steps
启用当前配置并继续游戏: Enable this profile and continue playing
继续游戏后停止界面导航。在窗口前台按 View + Menu 可暂停映射并切回手: Continuing the game stops interface navigation. With this window in front, press View + Menu to pause mapping and return to controller navigation.
每份游戏配置都可以导出为 TOML 文件。: Each game profile can be exported as a TOML file.
在动作映射中编辑虚拟手柄按键，可填入标准布局。: Edit virtual controller bindings in Action mapping, or fill in the standard layout.
用手柄操作游戏中的键盘与鼠标动作。: Use the controller for keyboard and mouse actions in games.
当前体感使用虚拟右摇杆。切换到键鼠前，请在「体感调校」将体感输出改为鼠标或关闭体: Gyro currently uses a virtual right stick. Before switching to keyboard/mouse output, choose mouse gyro output or disable gyro in Gyro tuning.
当前手柄可以录入触摸板按下。: This controller supports recording a touchpad click.
选择带触摸板按键的手柄接口后，即可验证点按输入。: Select a controller interface with a touchpad button to test click input.
虚拟 DualShock 4 的触摸板按键可在动作映射中绑定。: Bind the virtual DualShock 4 touchpad button in Action mapping.
可以添加触摸板点按动作。: You can add touchpad click actions.
添加手柄映射，或填入标准布局。: Add a controller binding or fill in the standard layout.
快捷键在映射或观察时生效。: Shortcuts work while mapping or monitoring is active.
开启后，在目标配置下再次触发此快捷键，会回到本轮自动切换前的配置。: When enabled, use this shortcut again from the target profile to return to the profile you were using before automatic switching.
最多支持 {0} 条快捷键规则: You can add up to {0} shortcut rules
同一个键盘快捷键只能用于一条切换规则: A keyboard shortcut can only be used in one switching rule
同一个手柄快捷键只能用于一条切换规则: A controller shortcut can only be used in one switching rule
拨动要录入的摇杆，回中后完成。: Move the stick you want to record, then let it return to center.
一次只录入一根摇杆，请重试。: Record one stick at a time. Try again.
所选手柄未连接，无法录入手柄输入。: The selected controller is disconnected. Connect it to record input.
每个配置最多支持 64 条手柄映射: A profile supports up to 64 controller bindings.
虚拟摇杆需要绑定实体摇杆: Bind a physical stick to the virtual stick.
手柄映射的输入或输出无效: The controller binding has an invalid input or output.
同一个虚拟摇杆或扳机只能绑定一条映射: Each virtual stick or trigger supports one binding.
配置层的手柄映射需为列表: Controller bindings in a layer must be a list.
已填入标准虚拟手柄布局: Filled in the standard virtual controller layout
导入支持完整的标准 Xbox／DS4 布局。可在动作映射中手动绑定自定义键位: Import supports complete standard Xbox or DS4 layouts. Bind custom buttons in Action mapping.
已包含在标准虚拟手柄布局中: Included in the standard virtual controller layout
添加第一个动作，例如“跳跃 → 空格 → A”。: Add your first action, such as Jump → Space → A.
点击已绑定的手柄控件可编辑动作。: Click a bound controller control to edit its action.
也可以直接点击表格中的键鼠操作或手柄输入开始录入。: You can also click a keyboard/mouse binding or controller input in the table to record it.
方向键或左摇杆移动，A 打开文件夹或选择文件，B 返回。支持 UTF-8、UTF: Use the D-pad or left stick to move, A to open a folder or select a file, and B to go back. Supports UTF-8, UTF-16 and Chinese ANSI text.
此文件夹没有可选的配置文件。: No supported configuration files in this folder.
此文件夹较大，仅显示前 1000 个项目。可直接输入更具体的文件夹路径。: This folder is large; only the first 1000 items are shown. Enter a more specific folder path.
在短按最长时间内松开后触发，输出持续时间与本次按压相同。: Triggers when released within the short-press limit and replays the duration of that press.
按下时输出一次，持续时间由下方设置决定。: Outputs once on press for the duration set below.
松开时输出一次，持续时间由下方设置决定。: Outputs once on release for the duration set below.
开启后，这条映射独立判断触发方式，可与同一输入的其他动作一起输出。: This binding evaluates its activator independently and can output alongside other actions on the same input.
同一输入有长按：普通动作等待松开；达到长按时间后只触发长按。: A long press shares this input: regular actions wait for release; reaching the long-press threshold activates only the long press.
同一输入有短按：短按时间内松开只触发短按；超过该时间后由其余触发方式决定输出。: A short press shares this input: releasing within its limit activates only the short press. Beyond that limit, the other activators determine the output.
同一输入有双击：单次按压需等待双击时间窗（{0} ms）结束；识别为双击后取消单: A double press shares this input: a single tap waits for the double-press window ({0} ms) to expire. Recognizing a double press cancels the single-tap action.
长按与双击共用输入时，先识别成功的触发方式生效，直到本次松开。: When long press and double press share an input, the first recognized gesture takes precedence until release.
模拟量映射连续传递摇杆位置或扳机行程。轻拉、全拉与摇杆方向可作为数字输入单独设置: Analog bindings continuously transmit stick position or trigger travel. Soft pull, full pull and stick directions can use separate digital activators.
模拟摇杆和扳机行程映射需要使用按住方式: Analog stick and trigger-travel bindings must use Hold mode
八向重叠：斜推同时触发相邻两键，例如 W+D；映射阈值按摇杆整体推离中心的幅度判: Eight-way overlap activates adjacent keys together on diagonals, such as W+D; the binding threshold uses total stick deflection. Per-axis threshold activates each direction when its own axis crosses the threshold.
统一用于方向映射与摇杆鼠标；外死区与特殊死区需核验: Used for direction bindings and stick mouse; verify outer and special deadzone behavior
已采用 JSM 八向重叠判定；斜向同时输出相邻两键，输入死区与其他摇杆模式需核验: Uses JSM eight-way overlap: diagonals output adjacent keys together. Verify the input deadzone and other stick modes
已转为摇杆区域输入；区域边界需核验: Converted to a stick-region input; verify the region boundaries
动作触发阈值必须在 0–1 之间（不含 1）: The action threshold must be between 0 and 1 (excluding 1)
